name: Item Attribute Errors Report
query:
SELECT 
    iva.parent as "Item Code:Link/Item:180",
    i.item_name as "Item Name:Data:250",
    iva.attribute as "Attribute:Data:200",
    iva.attribute_value as "Attribute Value:Data:150"
FROM 
    `tabItem Variant Attribute` iva
INNER JOIN 
    `tabItem` i ON iva.parent = i.name
LEFT JOIN 
    `tabItem Attribute Value` iav 
    ON iav.parent = iva.attribute 
    AND iav.attribute_value = iva.attribute_value
WHERE 
    iav.name IS NULL
    AND iva.attribute != "Variant Number"
    AND i.has_variants = 0
    AND iva.attribute_value IS NOT NULL
    AND iva.attribute_value != ''
ORDER BY 
    iva.attribute, iva.attribute_value, iva.parent
